title: I Told Mom I Was a Millionaire #shorts

lines.text: As a joke, I told my mom I became a millionaire.
She believed me instantly. By evening, she had told every neighbor on our street.
The next morning, twenty relatives showed up asking for loans.
I panicked. Mom, it was a prank!
She looked at me, smiled, and walked into her room.
She came back with an old tin box.
I saved your pocket money for ten years. It is for your dreams.
I opened it. Inside was four thousand rupees and a note.
I cried. Mom cried. Then the relatives asked for a loan.

sources: Original fictional story written for this channel

facts.hedge: fictional story, not a real event
